definitions.short: probably bronze or polished spectrum metal
definitions.full: H2830. chashmal חַשְׁמַל noun [masculine] etymology and exact meaning dubious; evidently some shining substance; AV amber; supposed by Thes (q. v.) and most to be a brilliant amalgam of gold and silver, ᵐ5 ἤλεκτρον (see Liddell & Scott under the word 2 ), ᵑ9 electrum ; see also Dl in Baer Ezech. xii ; only in the combination ח ׳כְּעֵין like the appearance of ׳ח Ezek 1:4 , 27 ; הַחַשְׁמַ֑לָה בְּעֵין 8:2 (on ending הָ֯ see Ges § 90 , 2 R a; Co strike out)
